title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description: Synthetic marketing role: plan and execute digital campaigns, keep CRM and lead-routing data accurate, measure campaign performance from engagement through handoff, and improve repeatable production workflows. Work with sales and creative partners to explain results without overclaiming attribution. Expected experience: at least 2 years in marketing operations or digital campaign delivery.
screening_criteria: Plan and execute multi-channel digital campaigns with documented handoffs.
Maintain CRM prospect data and lead-routing rules.
Measure campaign engagement and downstream outcomes with appropriate caveats.
At least 2 years of relevant marketing operations or digital campaign experience.

questions.text: Describe a campaign you delivered from brief through launch and what you owned.
How did you maintain CRM data and pass qualified leads to sales?
What campaign measures did you report, what could they not prove, and how long have you done this work?

requirements.description: Plan and execute multi-channel digital campaigns with documented handoffs.
Maintain CRM prospect data and lead-routing rules.
Measure campaign engagement and downstream outcomes with appropriate caveats.
At least 2 years of relevant marketing operations or digital campaign experience.
Use marketing automation or campaign production tools to reduce manual work.
Documented marketing or analytics training or equivalent relevant practical experience.
